newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST - Italy seen issuing 11 trln lire BOTs.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Italy seen issuing 11 trln lire BOTs.

text.p: The Italian Treasury is seen issuing 11 trillion lire short term bills (BOTs) and 4.5 trillion lire of zero coupon certificates (CTZ) at the mid-month auction on April 10, a Reuter poll showed on Friday.
Analysts on average see the Treasury issuing 2.5 trillion lire of a new October 15 1998 zero coupon certificates (CTZ) and 2.0 trillion lire of March 28 1999 CTZs.
Analysts noted recent comments by the Treasury saying it would try to balance the mid-month issue amounts with the end- month amounts in order to avoid sharp yield fluctuations.
The mid-month issues may be only slightly lower than the maturing paper.
Some 12.5 trillion lire of BOTs mature mid April, while the first CTZ maturities, for 8.5 trillion lire, will fall due at end April. Settlement for the paper is set on April 15.
